amendments.because: The owner's gate: the middle versions found 63% and 50% of real gaps against the original's 69-71%, below the 68% bar, so the original instructions come back with only the no-linked-spec exception
amendments.done_when: The cold-read instructions again ask the reader to name every decision a builder would otherwise have to guess (a name, format, rule, order or boundary two parts rely on, or that a Done-when item leaves open) and, for each Done-when item, the cases this story's own change must handle and which test proves each; they keep excluding generic platform or network traps the change doesn't meet, behaviour the story doesn't change, and a story having no linked spec. The command-level test checks both kinds of wording reach the prompt.

done_when: src/forge/templates/cold-read.md is back to its wording before the tightening (as at commit 67368bf4's parent), with one change kept: a story with no linked confirmed spec is not a finding, so the check that each Done-when item maps to the spec's behaviour or success measure applies only when a confirmed spec is included. Tests that pinned the tightened wording are updated to the restored contract, and a command-level test checks a story without a spec gets the conditional mapping wording.
why: The tightened plan-read instructions cut false alarms but missed 40% of real gaps in today's re-test, mostly decisions a builder would have to guess and missing proof for the story's own cases
